strings.report.badManifest: `{mod}` has a broken mod.json: `{field}` is wrong, got {got}
strings.report.noRuleset: No ruleset is ticked. Pick one base game, such as `base-ancient`
strings.report.twoRulesets: `{mod}` and `{other}` are both rulesets; only one can be used
strings.report.twoConversions: `{mod}` cannot be used with `{other}` (only one conversion per match)
strings.report.dependencyCycle: These mods each need another to load first, so none can: {mods}
strings.report.reordered: `{mod}` was moved to load after `{after}`, which it builds on
strings.report.optionSourceMissing: `{mod}` option `{option}` lists {source}, but no loaded mod defines any
strings.report.unknownOption: `{file}` in `{mod}` uses option `{option}`, which `{mod}` does not have
strings.report.missingFile: `{mod}` lists `{file}` in mod.json, but the file is missing
strings.report.badFile: `{file}` in `{mod}` needs a contentType and its entries, strings, values or set
strings.report.unknownContentType: `{file}` in `{mod}` uses content type `{contentType}`, which Atlas does not know
strings.report.duplicateId: `{file}` entry {index}: `{contentType}.{id}` already exists (use "op": "replace" to swap it)
strings.report.missingId: `{file}` entry {index}: cannot {op} `{contentType}.{id}`, which does not exist
strings.report.badOperation: `{file}` entry {index}: "{op}" is not a valid operation here
strings.report.badText: `{file}` in `{mod}`: text `{key}` must be words in quotes
strings.report.tuningValuesNotRuleset: `{file}` in `{mod}`: only a ruleset can set all of tuning at once; use "set" with dot paths
strings.report.noMatch: `{file}` entry {index} in `{mod}` removes {where}, which matched no {contentType}
strings.report.contentTypeMissing: `{file}` in `{mod}` edits {contentType}, which no loaded mod defines yet
strings.report.unknownField: `{file}` entry {index}: `{contentType}.{id}.{field}` is not a field Atlas uses
strings.report.badReference: `{field}` points to `{target}`, which does not exist
strings.report.refTypeMissing: `{field}` points to `{target}`, but no loaded mod defines any {contentType} yet
strings.report.missingText: `{field}` uses text `{key}`, which no loaded mod provides
